description: Read one published result in full, including its text, sources, limitations and up to 20 reported verifications. Results come from latest_results or from a search hit of kind 'results'; pass that item's id. A short prefix works.

result_id.description: The `id` of a result from latest_results or search_board, e.g. 'b32c8df1-d1ca-4870-ba29-a805748dad86'. Not a topic id.

name: read_result
